subject: Mac's Ship
text: The right path has a chest containing Refreshers.

evidence.quote: The right path has a chest containing Refreshers.

subject: Mac's Ship
text: Be sure to take the Gaia's Armor before getting to Captain Mac.

evidence.quote: Be sure to take the Gaia's Armor before getting to Captain Mac.

subject: Doom Castle
text: Before entering Doom Castle, make sure you are prepared with 99 Cure Potions, Seeds, and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Before entering, make sure that you are PREPARED. You can't be more safe with 99 Cure Potions, Seeds, and Heal Potions.

subject: Doom Castle
text: You will find the Aegis Shield on this platform.

evidence.quote: You will find the Aegis Shield on this platform.

subject: Doom Castle
text: A chest containing Cure Potions is found near a skull.

evidence.quote: You will automatically move to another skull and a chest containing Cure Potions.

subject: Skullrus Rex
text: Upon taking down the Shadows, begin pounding the Skullrus Rex with Flare from Benjamin and White from Phoebe.

evidence.quote: Upon taking down the Shadows, begin pounding the Skullrus Rex with Flare (Benjamin) and White (Phoebe).

subject: Skullrus Rex
text: If you can deal 2000+ damage with each move, the Skullrus Rex will die within 2.5 turns.

evidence.quote: If you can deal 2000+ damage with each move, the Skullrus Rex will die within 2.5 turns.

subject: Skullrus Rex
text: The only move you will want to watch out for is Sleep Powder, though Benjamin cannot be put to sleep.

evidence.quote: The only move you will want to watch out for is Sleep Powder. Luckily, Benjamin can't be put to sleep.

subject: Doom Castle
text: Stabbing the statue with Excalibur opens the door.

evidence.quote: stab the statue with your Excalibur. The door will thus open.

subject: Doom Castle
text: Go through the door and open the chest for some Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Simply go through the door and open the chest for some Heal Potions.

subject: Doom Castle
text: Pick up the Arrows from the chest.

evidence.quote: Pick up the Arrows from the chest and move through the door you opened previously.

subject: Doom Castle
text: You will come to a chest containing Refreshers on your way.

evidence.quote: You'll come to a chest containing Refreshers on your way.

subject: Doom Castle
text: Pick up the Arrows and defeat the Freezer Crab.

evidence.quote: Pick up the Arrows and defeat the Freezer Crab.

subject: Stone Golem
text: Two Cerberus accompany the Stone Golem.

evidence.quote: Two Cerberus's accompany the Stone Golem in all of his... well... stoniness!

subject: Stone Golem
text: Do not use Flare or Meteor because the Stone Golem is strong against those two spells.

evidence.quote: Don't use Flare or Meteor or the Stone Golem is strong against those two spells.

subject: Doom Castle
text: Defeat the Stheno and open both chests for some Arrows and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: Kill the Stheno and open both chests for some Arrows and Cure Potions.

subject: Doom Castle
text: The two chests contain Arrows and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: The two chests contain Arrows and Heal Potions.

subject: Twinhead Wyvern
text: The Twinhead Wyvern enters the fight with a Stheno and Iflyte as allies.

evidence.quote: The Twinhead Wyvern enters the fight with a Stheno and Iflyte as allies.

subject: Twinhead Wyvern
text: Do not use Flare or Fire because the Twinhead Wyvern is strong against flame-based spells; use Meteor or White instead.

evidence.quote: Do not use Flare or Fire in this fight. The Twinhead Wyvern is strong against flame-based spells. Instead, use Meteor or White.

subject: Twinhead Wyvern
text: It is best for Benjamin to cast Meteor while Phoebe casts White.

evidence.quote: I find it best for Benjamin to cast Meteor while Phoebe casts White.

subject: Doom Castle
text: Falling off the side down into the abyss will land you in the previous floor.

evidence.quote: Note that you can easily fall off the side here down into the abyss. You will land in the previous floor if you happen to do that.

subject: Zuh
text: Zuh and his Chimera and Thanatos allies are weak to Aero.

evidence.quote: Begin the fight by killing off his Chimera and Thanatos allies. Luckily for you, all three of your enemies are weak to Aero.

subject: Zuh
text: When Psychshield is up, do not attack, and repeatedly use Flare and White to win.

evidence.quote: Be wary of the Psychshield. When it's up, DO NOT attack unless you want to die young. To win, all you really have to do is repeatedly use Flare and White.

subject: Doom Castle
text: The walls surrounding the nearby chests will go down for access, and they contain 25 of whatever they are holding.

evidence.quote: The walls surrounding the nearby chests will go down for your access. They contain 25 of whatever they are holding.

subject: Dark King
text: Begin fighting the Dark King in his regular form by using White and Flare and other powerful spells.

evidence.quote: The Dark King begins in his regular form; lookin' all cool in his attire. Begin by using White and Flare and other powerful spells.

subject: Dark King
text: When the Dark King grows new arms, give Phoebe the role of healer while Benjamin uses Flare to deal about 2000 HP damage every turn.

evidence.quote: the Dark King will grow some new arms...I would just give Phoebe the role of healer now while Benjamin blasts away with Flare...you should deal about 2000 HP damage every turn at the least.

subject: Dark King
text: When the Dark King turns into a spider, watch out for Mega Flare and Laser while Phoebe cures and Benjamin uses Flare.

evidence.quote: Yeah, he turns into a spider. Use the same routine with Phoebe curing and Benjamin using Flare. At this point, begin to watch out for Mega Flare and Laser.

subject: Dark King
text: In his final form, have Phoebe continue to heal while a few more Flares defeat the Dark King.

evidence.quote: At long lasts, he'll finally transform into his final form; an octopussy-looking thing. Have Phoebe continue to heal the two. A few more Flares will finally put the Dark King in his place.
